body:
```
NVIM v0.13.0-dev-1946+g659164699f
Build type: RelWithDebInfo
LuaJIT 2.1.1792527110
```

## Release notes

- [Changelog](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/659164699f8d884a90b23829c0a0c5cc1ab38873) (fixes + features)
- [News](./runtime/doc/news.txt) (`:help news` in Nvim)

## Install

### Windows

#### Zip

1. Download **nvim-win64.zip** (or **nvim-win-arm64.zip** for ARM)
2. Extract the zip
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

#### MSI

1. Download **nvim-win64.msi** (or **nvim-win-arm64.msi** for ARM)
2. Run the MSI
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to [install `vcruntime*.dll`](https://neovim.io/doc/install/#windows).

### macOS (x86_64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### macOS (arm64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) [builds for older glibc](https://github.com/neovim/neovim-releases).

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (arm64)

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Other

- Install by [package manager](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/master/INSTALL.md#install-from-package)

name: v1.4.240
body:
## A more dependable workspace 🐳

This release gives the built-in browser searchable history, makes agent activity easier to follow, and improves recovery across chats and remote terminals. You’ll also find Lean and Zig syntax highlighting, support for larger quick-command collections, and a new `orca ports` command for finding your dev servers.

## The short version

- **Conversations that stay with you:** Claude chats now show turns made outside Orca. Retained messages return after reconnect without reopening the chat, and crash recovery no longer guesses that a sent message was undelivered.
- **A browser with a better memory:** Search your browsing history, reopen pages, remove unwanted suggestions, and clear history with Undo. Pages can also use files you pick, save or drop through File System Access.
- **Remote work with fewer interruptions:** Slow connections survive missed wake probes, reconnect notices explain what is happening, SSH terminals wait for sign-in, and new splits stay on the paired server.
- **Agent status you can trust:** Completed Codex subagents stop showing as Working, running main tasks stay visible through `/side` conversations, and Codex MCP tools that require approval get an approval card.
- **More room for your workflow:** Save more than 40 quick commands, find a worktree’s detected dev-server ports with `orca ports`, and reclaim old dependency installs and build output from development worktrees.
- **Polish where it counts:** Lean and Zig highlighting, clearer session-search excerpts, smoother Mac trackpad scrolling in terminal apps, and better protection for unmerged branches and worktrees shared between Windows and WSL.

**Phone & web updates:** Updating Orca on the computer serving your phone or browser updates the served interface. This release also keeps running Codex tasks visible on paired and mobile views during `/side` conversations and fixes browser-picked or dropped chat attachments uploading to the paired server.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Native chat (experimental):** Update paired and SSH hosts alongside Orca for the latest chat, agent-status and launch fixes. Codex’s new approval cards cover MCP tool approvals that do not require form fields; general MCP forms and URL-based verification are not supported by this change.
- **Browser history:** Open **History** from the page menu, or use **Cmd+Y** on macOS and **Ctrl+H** on Linux and Windows. Search, remove individual entries, or clear the last hour, today or all time, with Undo for clearing.
- **Detected ports:** `orca ports` supports workspace selection and JSON output on runtimes with host-scoped port scanning. Direct SSH hosts do not support detection yet; native folder workspaces require `--all` to list the host’s listeners.
- **Development cleanup:** Manual `pnpm reclaim-space` and automatic cleanup on development launches can reclaim ignored, untracked dependency installs and generated output in old sibling worktrees, using a default 30-day cutoff. Selected, invoking and excluded worktrees remain protected. Stop sibling apps, agents, installs, builds and tests before applying manual cleanup; reclaimed installs and output need reinstalling or rebuilding when used again.
- **Terminal file links:** The earlier change to open a file link in the workspace where it was clicked was reverted in this release.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat (experimental)

*Catch up on conversations, reconnect without extra steps, and answer agent prompts with clearer controls.*

* Show turns made outside Orca in an existing Claude chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31615
* Show retained chat messages after reconnect without reopening the chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32255
* Keep sent messages from being falsely marked undelivered after a crash, and stop scanning the transcript on every reopen by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30580
* Show approval cards for Codex MCP tools that require permission by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33310
* Submit Claude question-preview answers with Enter by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33332
* Match terminal pane split and close menus in chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28969
* Display unknown HTML tags as text instead of dropping them by @anmol0b in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30819
* Alert the orchestration coordinator when a chat worker errors by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31941
* Deliver follow-ups to running Codex goals using the choices the goal inherits by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33300
* Upload chat attachments picked or dropped in a web client to the paired server by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33060

### Agent activity & integrations

*See the task that is actually running, keep completed work settled, and launch agents with the right session and settings.*

* Record Stop immediately and settle subagents when their exit is confirmed by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28051
* Clear stale Working status for completed Codex subagents by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32937
* Show reference-origin icons and native-chat origins in the sidebar by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33049
* Retain completion subtitles for paired workspaces by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/9930
* Remove Claude teammates stopped with TaskStop from the sidebar by @davidgarciab in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32048
* Keep agent questions visible when a stale program report says Working by @maxmilian in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32156
* Preserve running-agent hook status through idle title repaints by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32195
* Restart initial agent-detection probes when their results are invalidated by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32558
* Keep Codex status tied to the main task through `/side` chats after restart by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33275
* Keep a running Codex turn visible on paired and mobile views while `/side` is shown by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33308
* Resume Claude panes whose environment scrubbing removed their pane identity by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33286
* Find Antigravity’s usage command in the same environment used to launch agents by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33289
* Refresh OpenCode credential status after saving by @Pr1p in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33081
* Read Kimi Code 2.x usage from its scoped OAuth configuration by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33290
* Bound retries when generating an agent’s first-work name by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33299
* Prevent Claude agent-hook runs from creating phantom subagent rows by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33298
* Accept OpenCode release ranges when selecting a launch-time model by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33307
* Preserve concurrent edits during a remote Hermes reinstall by @Shy7777 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20631
* Keep a cold-restored terminal’s agent session without showing an old Done status by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33302
* Attribute shared Hermes gateway events to the correct session pane by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33288
* Let branded Pi forks reach launch readiness by setting their initial session title by @thefrikidude in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28317
* Preserve a fresh agent’s chat identity when an older shell title arrives by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33306
* Mark a Pi answer unread before the compaction that follows it by @mmarabel in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33272
* Back off Antigravity usage reads that trigger browser sign-in by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33297
* Let paired hosts plan terminal-agent launches from the composer by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32192

### Browser

*Find a page again, manage what appears in suggestions, and use web apps with local files more naturally.*

* Add searchable browsing history, removable suggestions and Chrome-style Escape behavior in the address bar by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31846
* Let pages use files picked, saved or dropped through File System Access by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32970
* Render dark-scheme documents on a dark canvas in previews by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32975
* Refresh browser profiles changed outside the window without a reload by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32723
* Keep a closed host page from lingering as a window-saved browser tab by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33266

### Terminals & remote connections

*Type, scroll, split and reconnect with fewer interruptions, while keeping sessions on the host where they belong.*

* Wait for SSH sign-in before starting a terminal opened during authentication by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33072
* Start a split on the paired server even when it follows immediately after opening a tab by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33078
* Keep slow remote connections open when a wake probe is missed by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33071
* Show one reconnect notice per server, explain the cause, and account for measured connection latency by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33095
* Reattach remote panes on the host’s next snapshot after a host-exit settlement by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33062
* Remove an exited original pane on paired clients consistently with split panes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33083
* Record why remote connections closed in app diagnostics by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33094
* Preserve terminal output and parsing order through resizes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32750
* Avoid republishing session tabs on every Codex thread-name spinner tick by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33291
* Keep keys typed before a pane’s terminal is ready by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33281
* Keep Mac trackpad flicks continuous in full-screen terminal apps by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33313
* Prevent “104;255” from leaking into agent prompts after a tab switch by @ivermin1123 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31411
* Recheck previously missing paths so terminal file links become clickable by @mmarabel in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/6282
* Prevent terminal creation from reviving tabs that were already closed by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32190
* Restart shell panes in split agent tabs as shells by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32418
* Report when a terminal has stopped accepting input instead of claiming delivery by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33269
* Answer background terminal startup queries while the paired view is paused by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33273
* Limit **Reconnect & Delete** to the selected SSH workspace by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33253
* Move managed SSH tunnels away from saved local ports that cannot be bound by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33271
* Match SSH conversion manifest signing to the host’s parsing by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32369
* Stop paired desktops from republishing mirrored editor tabs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33259
* Keep probed host capabilities available after host-status updates by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33263
* Prevent a server liveness check from mistaking its own shell for the server by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33158
* Allow different workspaces to sleep at the same time without failing by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33283
* Add opt-in proxy connection reuse for system SSH on Windows by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33030
* Start managed servers with a smaller V8 young generation by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31494
* Respect both configured and cell-reported relay connection limits by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33039
* Move relay hosts off an isolated cell while its replacement starts by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33312
* Use a consistent numeric locale for POSIX agent-hook curl timeouts by @siddiqueirshad in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19600
* Remove eager regex lookbehind from paired web routes for browser compatibility by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32906

### Source control, workspaces & Windows / WSL

*Keep project actions on the right host, protect branches and worktrees, and let cold WSL distributions finish starting.*

* Recognize GitLab SSH-over-443 remotes by @lorenzozanee in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30998
* Recognize Bitbucket remotes using ssh.bitbucket.org by @Pr1p in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31002
* Preserve Source Control section collapse state by @just-zzp in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/9405
* Back off failed GitLab authentication probes by @1aifanatic in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26742
* Hide stale merged PRs after the workspace HEAD changes by @xianjianlf2 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/7815
* Protect worktrees created by the other Git installation on Windows or WSL from pruning by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33103
* Include the registry addon when relocating the Windows daemon host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32194
* Retry Git reads after transient wsl.exe service errors during distro startup by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33145
* Keep the worktree watcher from interrupting a cold WSL distro’s boot by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33175
* Avoid synchronous WSL home-directory probes at startup and premature termination of a booting distro by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33179

### Developer tools & everyday polish

*Find running dev servers, keep larger command collections, and make the small interactions feel more considered.*

### Tests, builds & maintenance

name: v0.8.198
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.198

Released on 2026-10-25.

Cloud renders now split the work by how costly each part is to capture, so one heavy stretch no longer holds up the rest. On a heavy 4K test project that made renders about a third faster at the same cost. Snapshot also waits for slow scenes, and renders hide statically hidden elements the way preview does.

## Fixes

- **CLI:** Snapshot waits for a slow scene to finish building instead of saving a stale frame ([6b424e02c4987](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6b424e02c498746d922a7cbda6e63f206c55c9d4), [#6290](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6290)).
- **Core:** Hide static data-hidden elements in render as preview does ([36b2c3c2b9a48](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/36b2c3c2b9a48b2205b5a9407761abf394e64ee5), [#6296](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6296)).
- **Producer:** Refuse private and non-HTTPS previewUrl fetches ([683e9b1765aa1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/683e9b1765aa1d4d45f91ac000b6e65f7767d728), [#6297](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6297)).

## Performance

- **Producer:** Cut distributed chunks by estimated capture cost ([aae32e43eddb3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/aae32e43eddb39c5ac698e4ed0dc98e175c9dd26), [#6295](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6295)).

## Docs & Examples

- **Start:** The Studio app first, the browser editor named, a showcase wall that renders ([f5ab7711fb8d0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f5ab7711fb8d0a3a0dea8bebc8e959448dac02d4), [#6303](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6303)).

## Internal

- **Release:** Keep the packed release tarballs as an artifact on release pull requests ([e938e53ea6952](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e938e53ea6952bbd587e47de1b7c961da31c9eb7), [#6292](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6292)).

# HyperFrames v0.8.197

Released on 2026-10-25.

Cloud renders of opaque VP9 video use compressed frames instead of lossless ones, which cuts their cost by about 40 percent. Snapshot reports a clip it cannot read instead of saving a black frame, and Studio frees each closed project's memory.

## Features

- **Lint:** Warn when a round-capped line hidden by its dash settings can still show a dot ([2bff65b0cd13d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2bff65b0cd13da6613e8d64e9202a0569ff6cdfa), [#6291](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6291)).

## Fixes

- **Sdk:** Release the parsed film when a session is disposed ([495dc95acdf73](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/495dc95acdf738f419eb644439ca1e90b94b511e), [#6289](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6289)).
- **CLI:** Snapshot fails with the clip and time instead of a silent black frame ([a7273f71478b4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a7273f71478b43147faa6c426188ef2383142547), [#6274](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6274)).
- **CLI:** A check that is stopped by a signal prints the report it has so far ([1f740ca21a4ab](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1f740ca21a4ab2e90116ecfcc553e87ed7241062), [#6282](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6282)).

## Performance

- **Engine:** Vp9 and vp8 sources without an alpha plane extract as jpeg ([382a14d73e7ab](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/382a14d73e7ab5b77f2c118a012338364c4373b8), [#6284](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6284)).
- **Core:** Text edits stop rebuilding the preview's caches every frame ([751ca755f21e1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/751ca755f21e14e9094fdc077f681e4914ca6c3d), [#6276](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6276)).

## Internal

- Two flaky queue tests no longer race real time or the first copy's start ([4d154c6a237f4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4d154c6a237f47d03ba6bd087afce1042620d706), [#6283](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6283)).

# HyperFrames v0.8.194

Released on 2026-10-25.

Undo and restore in Studio keep the media they delete or replace, so a history step never loses a file. Motion blur no longer blacks out videos inside sub-compositions, and around 25 smaller fixes land across the CLI, core and lint.

## Features

- **Studio:** The blur panel turns on events with blur ([19374955c7bc8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/19374955c7bc88735a0ae6a0aea63c213a31505d), [#6255](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6255)).

Released on 2026-10-24.

Cloud renders of long, cut-heavy edits finish several times faster at the same or lower cost. Audio renders work again on FFmpeg 4.4.

## Fixes

- **Engine:** Audio encodes on FFmpeg 4.4, which has no setts duration option ([3d45d1b037860](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3d45d1b037860afd42439a2b4ca7e0dc762448c3), [#6219](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6219)).
- **CLI:** Each start sweeps the running markers of CLIs that are gone ([24965372dbbec](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/24965372dbbec90391978e223616c75045b9a813), [#5790](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5790)).
- **CLI:** Snapshot rejects a negative --at and builds its sheet from its own frames ([80be6ff039bb7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/80be6ff039bb7bb9c4ad2160441cf25fc29faf26), [#6179](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6179)).
- **CLI:** Snapshot seeks into a HEVC cut whose index lands a keyframe early ([3cbd98890e6f6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3cbd98890e6f6f2c9544e753deedbd658486b569), [#6217](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6217)).
- **Studio Server:** A history restore refuses to remove every tracked file ([0eae4946d33f3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0eae4946d33f3d874478fa7a292f3aae6a669ce1), [#6175](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6175)).
- **Engine:** Disable Dawn's DXC on Windows so WebGPU requestDevice succeeds ([3dc0b97bfdfe3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3dc0b97bfdfe33cfb44c3655bd2849a4981e3842), [#5830](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5830)).
- **Studio:** A scene swap no longer keeps the previous preview window in memory ([291144e87ddfe](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/291144e87ddfee93a3cd01764810311f0b5c5016), [#6207](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6207)).
- **Core:** Color grading builds a new WebGL context when a lost one is never restored ([700187b855de3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/700187b855de3cd35d9094e5006407dddd41a2ce), [#6211](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6211)).
- **Producer:** A render's page-error count includes what the capture workers saw ([1ab871fb117aa](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1ab871fb117aa4a5172c9d28c4c3d4556cedebbc), [#6196](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6196)).
- **Engine:** Renames ride out Windows file locks instead of failing the render ([0a8a78edec413](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0a8a78edec413f04b127ac2454f071793bd83000), [#6210](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6210)).

## Performance

- **AWS Lambda:** Cloud renders plan without reading video bytes and start chunks sooner ([da4386f0d0695](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/da4386f0d06955cbdd09bce5a6e837f4c657654f), [#6194](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6194)).

## Docs & Examples

- **Skills:** Say which font faces are bundled and which are fetched ([8811f0bfbf3e7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8811f0bfbf3e7fb514e01c2eeb4244692fc4afd0), [#6197](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6197)).

## Internal

- **CLI:** The lifecycle suite lets background imports settle before it resets modules ([dd1cba49de4e1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/dd1cba49de4e1e610479d9e177a0c200f801da2a), [#6216](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6216)).
- The lifecycle and thumbnail suites load cold modules in a hook, not in their first test ([1a238171ec558](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1a238171ec55896a9cb8452c33e4e0fe1063a60c), [#6212](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6212)).

name: Reasonix Studio v2.51.0
body:
本版新增视频壁纸、查找框的大小写与正则开关、快捷键一览和长对话分页加载，正文栏可拖得更窄，并修复多处保存、粘贴与显示问题。

## 新增

- 壁纸可以选 MP4 或 WebM 视频，作为静音循环的动态壁纸；窗口隐藏或失焦、系统减弱动效或精简效果下停在第一帧。关联 #14357。
- 对话里的查找框多了两个开关：区分大小写，以及把查询当作正则表达式。关联 #14198 by @imcreazy。
- 设置的外观页增加「快捷键」一栏，列出窗口里所有可用按键，可以搜「快捷键」「Ctrl」「Esc」等词找到。关联 #14198 by @imcreazy。
- agent 浏览器的网页可在「设置 → 外观」开启空闲休眠：15 分钟无人使用后整页收起省内存，再用时恢复为同一标签页。默认关闭。关联 #14332 by @jf200s。
- 版本列表里的下载和后台自动下载现在都可以取消；取消会停止传输，并删除这次下载留下的部分文件。关联 #14338。
- 新增可选的历史接口，按页读取正文并保留稳定的消息位置和跨页工具上下文；现有客户端继续全量读取。关联 #14048、#14087 by @SivanCola。

## 变更

- 壁纸不再有 12 MB 上限，原样使用你选的图片；上传改为边收边写入磁盘，读取支持分段，大文件不再占满内存。关联 #13980。
- 正文字宽现在可以连续拖到 640px，不再停在「适宜阅读」的 760px；按 Home 或不拖动时仍是 760px。关联 #14384。
- 阅读栏左右两侧的拖动把手平时不再显示，鼠标移到栏边缘才出现，拖动和键盘调整不变。关联 #14352 fixed in #14353。
- 移除工作台的「加宽」按钮、独立加宽模式及 Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+B；可拖动分隔条或聚焦后用方向键调宽。关联 #14324 fixed in #14335 by @lancy69。
- 轮次多的对话里，右侧提问细条会把相邻几条折成一组，悬停显示涵盖的范围；右键某条可加书签。关联 #14198 by @imcreazy。
- 「运行分析」入口变成图标加文字，分析页标题左侧多了返回箭头；点已在屏上的会话会回到正文。关联 #14198 by @imcreazy。
- 导出会话多了 Markdown 格式：只保留提问与回答，按发生顺序；JSON 仍保留全部字段。关联 #14198 by @imcreazy。
- 开启「派发」后，把任务派到侧边栏里你自己的项目时，不再因该项目尚未决定信任而停在信任卡上。关联 #13341。
- 没有选过项目也没有记住的项目时，首次启动不再打开用户主目录，而是打开应用自己管理的一个小目录，它不会被记成项目。关联 #14363。
- 输入 `/` 后可继续输入描述中的关键词查找技能和命令；名称匹配仍优先于描述匹配。关联 #14323 fixed in #14344 by @lancy69。
- 工具参数缺必填项、待办列表规则不符、diff 证据被拒时，报错会直接给出合法示例或改用 files 证据的出路。关联 #14311。
- 支持分页的服务端优先显示最近消息；读取旧页保留阅读位置和控件，搜索会提示历史覆盖不完整。关联 #14048、#14087 by @SivanCola。

## 修复

- 切回「发送反馈」标签或点击反馈窗口标题后，Ctrl+V 也能添加截图；打开窗口后立刻粘贴也不再被偶尔忽略。关联 #14205 fixed in #14333 by @lancy69、#14333 by @lancy69。
- 新对话第一次保存前在右侧提问细条上加的书签，保存后不再消失，重启后也不会出现在另一段新对话里。关联 #14296 by @imcreazy。
- 接口报告「缓存命中 0」时按完全未命中计算，缓存命中率不再虚高；异常的超额命中被截断，99.5% 以上不再写成 100%。关联 #14313 by @jf200s。
- 后台任务启动时的提示按界面语言显示为「后台任务已开始：…」，不再是唯一的英文。关联 #14308。
- 正文字宽的两个手柄在第一次拖过之后不再失效；拖动时两侧栏按各自比例让位，输入框跟随正文变宽。关联 #14320 by @imcreazy。
- 展开待办计划时，右侧消息细条和「跳到最新 / 回到顶部」按钮不再被顶起；计划面板浮在输入框上方。关联 #14321 by @imcreazy。
- 上下文压缩完成后的诊断行按界面语言写成一句话，不再是英文 key=value。关联 #14307。
- 工作台右键菜单合并编辑操作与「加入对话」；阅读和只读视图不显示修改操作，未选中文字时不显示引用。关联 #14326 fixed in #14348 by @lancy69。
- 还没确认的提问卡片滚出视野再回来后，已勾选的选项、自填文字、补充说明和所在题目会保留。关联 #14336 fixed in #14337。
- 用智能体预设建的会话，升级后因内置工具变化不再变成只能查看；按当时记录的工具继续，并提示一次。关联 #14360 fixed in #14370。
- 执行过程那一行的「N 项运行中 / 失败 / 操作」和标题现在字号、字重一致。关联 #14364。
- 自动命名时标题模型把输出额度都花在思考上，程序会放宽额度重试一次，而不是直接失败。关联 #14374。
- 设置「存储」里「导入原生会话」的卡片不再露出浏览器自带的文件选择框，改用应用风格按钮。关联 #14378。
- 子代理以及计划者、Guardian 的文件读取各用独立记录，不再刷新执行代理的过期文件保护而覆盖你的修改。关联 #14025、#14133 by @SivanCola。
- Guardian 自身的 `use_capability` 调用对真实目标做只读检查，拒绝写入和已声明的宿主变更。关联 #14025、#14133 by @SivanCola。
- 重启后 Git 暂时不可用时保留隔离结果的文件和 ID；恢复前核对托管目录与仓库身份，错配的记录保留且不会被清理或应用。关联 #14025、#14133 by @SivanCola。
- 乐观模式下的任务写入会检查兄弟任务占用，包含动态本地工具；不相交的写入仍可并行。关联 #14025、#14133 by @SivanCola。

## 升级须知

- 派发到侧边栏里没决定过信任的项目时，该项目会被记为已信任并直接发出任务；家目录等不可整体信任的文件夹仍会询问。关联 #13341。
- 乐观模式下，同一文件被兄弟任务占用时，后到的写入会以 write.path_busy 被拒绝，而不再静默覆盖。关联 #14025。

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@imcreazy、@jf200s、@SivanCola、@lancy69

---

<!-- lang:en -->

This release adds video wallpapers, case and regex switches in find, a shortcut sheet and paged loading of long conversations, lets the reading column go narrower, and fixes several saving, pasting and display problems.

## New

- A wallpaper can be an MP4 or WebM video, played muted and looping; it stays on its first frame while the window is hidden or unfocused, under reduced motion or reduced effects. Refs #14357.
- The find bar gained two switches: match case, and read the query as a regular expression. Refs #14198 by @imcreazy.
- The appearance settings gained a keyboard shortcut sheet listing every chord the window answers to, reachable by searching "shortcut", "Ctrl" or "Esc". Refs #14198 by @imcreazy.
- Agent browser pages can sleep when idle (Settings → Appearance): a page nobody drives for 15 minutes is folded away and wakes as the same tab. Off by default. Refs #14332 by @jf200s.
- A version download, started from the version list or by automatic download, can now be cancelled; cancelling stops the transfer and removes the partial files. Refs #14338.
- An optional history API reads the transcript in bounded pages with stable positions and cross-page tool context; existing clients keep full reads. Refs #14048, #14087 by @SivanCola.

## Changed

- Wallpapers have no 12 MB limit and are used as chosen; the upload is written to disk as it arrives and served in ranges, so a large one no longer fills memory. Refs #13980.
- The reading column can be dragged continuously down to 640px instead of stopping at 760px; Home and an untouched window still give 760px. Refs #14384.
- The reading column's resize grips no longer draw at rest; they appear under the pointer or on keyboard focus, and dragging and keys are unchanged. Refs #14352 fixed in #14353.
- Removed Widen mode, its button and Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+B; use the divider or the arrow keys on it to resize. Refs #14324 fixed in #14335 by @lancy69.
- A long conversation folds neighbouring questions in the rail into one line and names the range on hover; right click stars one. Refs #14198 by @imcreazy.
- The run analysis entry reads as words beside its icon, the page has a back arrow, and picking a conversation already on screen returns to reading. Refs #14198 by @imcreazy.
- A conversation can be exported as Markdown, keeping only the questions and answers in order; JSON still carries every field. Refs #14198 by @imcreazy.
- With dispatch on, a task sent to a project in your sidebar no longer stops on its trust card because you hadn't decided about it yet. Refs #13341.
- With no chosen or remembered project, a first launch opens a small folder the app owns instead of your home directory; it is never remembered as a project. Refs #14363.
- Type description keywords after `/` to find skills and commands; name matches still rank first. Refs #14323 fixed in #14344 by @lancy69.
- A tool call missing a required field, a todo list breaking a rule, and a diff citation for command-made changes now show a valid example or the files-evidence way out. Refs #14311.
- Paging servers show the latest messages first; older pages keep your reading position and controls, and search says when history is incomplete. Refs #14048, #14087 by @SivanCola.

## Fixed

- Pasting a screenshot works after returning to the Send feedback tab or clicking the dialog heading, and a paste right after opening is no longer sometimes ignored. Refs #14205 fixed in #14333 by @lancy69, #14333 by @lancy69.
- A question starred in the rail before a new conversation is first saved stays starred, and no longer reappears in another unsaved conversation after a restart. Refs #14296 by @imcreazy.
- A request reported with zero cache hits counts as a full miss, so the hit rate no longer drifts up; over-reported hits are clamped and 99.5% no longer shows as 100%. Refs #14313 by @jf200s.
- The notice shown when a background job starts is worded in the interface language instead of staying the one English line. Refs #14308.
- The reading column's grips no longer stop after the first drag; sidebars give way while dragging and the composer follows the width. Refs #14320 by @imcreazy.
- Opening the todo plan no longer pushes the message rail or the jump buttons up; the panel floats above the composer. Refs #14321 by @imcreazy.
- The line shown after a context fold is one sentence in the interface language, not an English key=value dump. Refs #14307.
- Workbench text menus combine editing and Add to conversation, respect read-only views and selection, and keep focus and undo/redo. Refs #14326 fixed in #14348 by @lancy69.
- An unanswered ask card keeps its picks, typed text, notes and current question when it scrolls out of view and back. Refs #14336 fixed in #14337.
- A conversation bound to an Agent preset no longer turns read-only after an upgrade changes a built-in tool; it continues with the recorded tools and says so once. Refs #14360 fixed in #14370.
- The running / failed / action counts on the activity line now share the title's size and weight. Refs #14364.
- When the title model spends its whole output budget thinking, automatic naming asks once more with room for the title instead of failing. Refs #14374.
- The "Import a native session" card in Settings → Storage no longer shows the browser's own file input; it uses an app-styled button. Refs #14378.
- Reads by child tasks, the Planner and the Guardian use their own records and no longer refresh the executor's stale-file guard and overwrite your edits. Refs #14025, #14133 by @SivanCola.
- The Guardian's own `use_capability` calls enforce read-only execution on the real target, refusing writes and declared host mutations. Refs #14025, #14133 by @SivanCola.
- After a restart with Git unavailable, an isolated result keeps its files and ID; recovery checks managed paths and repository identity, and a mismatched record stays untouched. Refs #14025, #14133 by @SivanCola.
- Optimistic task writes honour live sibling claims, including dynamically resolved local tools; disjoint writes stay parallel. Refs #14025, #14133 by @SivanCola.

## Upgrade notes

- Dispatching to a sidebar project you have not decided about records it as trusted and sends the task; folders that cannot be trusted whole, such as your home directory, still ask. Refs #13341.
- In optimistic mode, a write to a file a sibling task holds is refused with write.path_busy instead of silently overwriting it. Refs #14025.

## Contributors

Thanks to this release's contributors: @imcreazy, @jf200s, @SivanCola, @lancy69

## What's Changed
* test(delegation): observe the running fleet job before the children are released by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14316
* fix(stats): an endpoint's zero cache hit is a full miss, not an absence by @jf200s in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14313
* feat(studio): match case and regular expressions in the find bar by @imcreazy in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14301
* feat(studio): export a conversation as Markdown by @imcreazy in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14299
* fix(studio): make run analysis easy to enter and to leave by @imcreazy in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14294
* fix(jobs): a started background job is announced with a code and its payload, so it follows the language by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14317
* feat(studio): fold a crowded conversation rail, and let a question be starred by @imcreazy in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14296
* feat(studio): a shortcut sheet in the settings by @imcreazy in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14300
* Keep the plan panel from pushing the rail and the jump arrows by @imcreazy in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14321
* fix(compaction): a finished fold is announced with a code and a typed payload, so it follows the language by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14322
* Let the reading column's grips, sidebars and composer move together by @imcreazy in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14320
* fix(studio): route feedback image paste through the dialog by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14333
* feat(browser): a page nobody drives sleeps, and wakes as the same target by @jf200s in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14332
* fix(studio): an unanswered ask card keeps its picks when its block unmounts by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14337
* fix(migrate): an imported session completes its sidecar by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14213
* build(deps): bump zod from 3.25.76 to 4.6.6 in /workers/forum by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14339
* build(deps-dev): bump fast-uri from 3.1.8 to 3.1.9 in /tools/acp-conformance by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14340
* build(deps): bump undici from 8.12.1 to 8.12.3 in /desktop/frontend-next by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14342
* fix(studio): the feedback form takes a paste in the commit that draws it by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14347
* fix(completion): find slash skills by description by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14344
* fix(studio): the reading column's grips draw nothing until the pointer is on them by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14353
* feat(studio): first run without a picked workspace by @Oliver-Rui in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14351
* feat(studio): cancel an update download from the Versions panel by @1012905 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14345
* fix(studio): remove redundant workbench widening mode by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14335
* docs: remove the first-run workspace design (moved to #14363) by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14367
* feat(studio): wallpapers upload as a streamed body, have no size limit and are served in ranges by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14369

name: Codewhale v0.10.2
body:
## What's in v0.10.2


Codewhale v0.10.2 adds an animated pet view (`/pet on`), a live Terminal work
dock, per-chat composer colors (`/color`) and a one-time note on the first
start after an update that says what changed. It closes three session
data-loss paths and a `codewhale web` session leak; adds the default Runtime
daemon socket locations to the sandbox deny-list; holds a `curl` or `wget` that uploads a
credential; refuses shell commands containing invisible Unicode; keeps the
Linux sandbox working when a hidden credential directory is a symlink; and
reduces idle TUI redraw work. `/undo` takes back a whole
request, including long and multiline prompts. `exec --auto` explains its
Full Access default, honors an explicitly stricter sandbox, and saves
tool-enabled runs and their failure receipts. Local runtimes appear during
onboarding, `/diff` works outside a Git repository, DeepSeek's Responses route
no longer rejects replayed tool history, and contributor fixes improve token
accounting, relay model lists, localized replies and Windows launcher
guidance. Delegated work continues without model-invented turn or time caps,
and independent workflow steps can continue after another child fails.

## Install

### Recommended — official GitHub release

New macOS/Linux install (checksummed binaries from this release):

```bash
curl -fsSL https://codewhale.net/install.sh | CODEWHALE_VERSION="v0.10.2" sh
"$HOME/.local/bin/codewhale" --version
```

For Windows, use the matching installer or archive below. For an existing
direct install, run `codewhale update`; it prints the executable path and
keeps newer builds. If the install directory is occupied by a different build,
use the fresh-directory migration in [the installation guide](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/CodeWhale/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md).

### Secondary packaging — npm and Cargo

```bash
npm install -g codewhale
# or build from source
cargo install codewhale-cli --locked
```

The wrapper downloads the matched `codewhale` and `codew` command assets
from this Release. Both contain the same compiled runtime.

### Docker / GHCR

```bash
docker run --rm -it \
  -e DEEPSEEK_API_KEY="$DEEPSEEK_API_KEY" \
  -v codewhale-home:/home/codewhale/.codewhale \
  ghcr.io/codewhale-hq/codewhale:v0.10.2
```

The image exposes the same runtime as both `codewhale` and `codew`. The
`latest` tag is also updated on release.

### Cargo (Linux / macOS)

```bash
cargo install codewhale-cli --locked
```

The Cargo package installs `codewhale`. Cargo cannot create a second command
alias from one binary target; users who want the shorter spelling can add a
`codew` symlink to that installed executable. The npm, Homebrew, archive,
shell-installer, and container channels install both command names directly.

### Manual download — platform archives (recommended)

Each archive below contains the same runtime under the `codewhale` and
`codew` command names, plus an install script:

| Platform | Archive | Install script |
|---|---|---|
| Linux x64 | `codewhale-linux-x64.tar.gz` | `install.sh` |
| Linux ARM64 | `codewhale-linux-arm64.tar.gz` | `install.sh` |
| Android ARM64 (Termux) | `codewhale-android-arm64.tar.gz` | `install.sh` |
| macOS x64 | `codewhale-macos-x64.tar.gz` | `install.sh` |
| macOS ARM | `codewhale-macos-arm64.tar.gz` | `install.sh` |
| Windows x64 (installer) | `CodeWhaleSetup.exe` | NSIS setup |
| Windows x64 | `codewhale-windows-x64.zip` | `install.bat` |
| Windows x64 (portable) | `codewhale-windows-x64-portable.zip` | — |
| Windows ARM64 | `codewhale-windows-arm64.zip` | `install.bat` |
| Windows ARM64 (portable) | `codewhale-windows-arm64-portable.zip` | — |

**Unix (Linux / macOS):**
```bash
tar xzf codewhale-<platform>.tar.gz
cd codewhale-<platform>
./install.sh
```

**Windows:**
- For the installer path, run `CodeWhaleSetup.exe`; it installs
  `codewhale.exe`, `codew.exe`, and `codewhale.bat` under
  `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\CodeWhale\bin`, adds that directory to the
  current-user PATH, and creates a Start Menu shortcut that prefers
  Windows Terminal (`wt.exe`) when it is installed.
- Extract the archive for your machine: `codewhale-windows-x64.zip` or
  `codewhale-windows-arm64.zip`
- Double-click `codewhale.bat` (not the raw `.exe`) to launch
- Run `install.bat` to copy the binaries and launcher to `%USERPROFILE%\bin`
- Add `%USERPROFILE%\bin` to your PATH

The **portable** Windows archive skips the install script — extract and run `codewhale.bat` from any directory. The NSIS installer is currently unsigned and may trigger Windows SmartScreen until a signing certificate is wired into the release pipeline.

Each platform also has **bare, unarchived** `codewhale-<platform>` and
`codew-<platform>` assets. The seven `codewhale-tui-<platform>` filenames
attached to v0.9.5 are byte-identical compatibility copies used only to let
already-installed v0.9.4 clients discover and cross this single-binary
transition; current installers do not expose a third runtime. The legacy npm
package `deepseek-tui` is deprecated and is not republished. For migration
from v0.8.x legacy binary names, see `docs/REBRAND.md`.

### Verify (recommended)

Download the checksum manifests from this Release and verify:

```bash
# Linux — archive bundles
sha256sum -c codewhale-bundles-sha256.txt --ignore-missing

# Linux — individual binaries
sha256sum -c codewhale-artifacts-sha256.txt --ignore-missing

# macOS
shasum -a 256 -c codewhale-bundles-sha256.txt --ignore-missing
shasum -a 256 -c codewhale-artifacts-sha256.txt --ignore-missing
```

<details>

<summary>Full release notes</summary>

The full notes exceed GitHub's release-description limit. Read the [complete changelog for v0.10.2](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/CodeWhale/blob/v0.10.2/CHANGELOG.md).

</details>

name: v0.21.36
body:
# oh-my-codex v0.21.36

`0.21.36` is a patch release that routes native-hook CLI error diagnostics through the configured OMX logs directory.

Native-hook CLI error logs now follow `omxLogsDir`: `OMX_ROOT` takes precedence over `OMX_STATE_ROOT`, and the project `.omx/logs` behavior is unchanged when neither is configured. This fixes #3908.

## Highlights

- **NATIVE HOOK LOGGING (#3909):** CLI error diagnostics use the configured `omxLogsDir`, honoring `OMX_ROOT` and `OMX_STATE_ROOT` instead of always writing beneath the project working directory.

## Compatibility

- No breaking API changes.
- `OMX_ROOT` takes precedence over `OMX_STATE_ROOT` for native-hook CLI error logs; with neither configured, logs continue to use the project `.omx/logs` directory.

## Known issues

- #3898 (live-pin fix) remains blocked on an owner design decision; #3900 and #3907 are open drafts. On Codex 0.164.0, `.omx-live-pin` files in the plugin cache can invalidate hook approval. The workaround posted in #3898 disables the `oh-my-codex-local` plugin.

## Validation

- Pinned dev candidate `4932ef923a15a5bf818f5b4fa2625d3259486275` passed CI run [40160210335](https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-codex/actions/runs/40160210335): latest-per-name checks were 17 success, 8 skipped, and 0 failures.
- Both macOS Ralplan preflight security jobs passed: Node 20 (job 121070025433) and Node 26.5.1 (job 121070025331).
- Release-branch local gates and release-PR review/CI are recorded in `docs/qa/release-readiness-0.21.36.md`.

## Merged PR inventory

| PR | Author | Title |
|---|---|---|
| [#3909](https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-codex/pull/3909) | @Yeachan-Heo | fix(native-hook): route CLI error logs through omxLogsDir |
| [#3906](https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-codex/pull/3906) | @Yeachan-Heo | chore(back-merge): v0.21.35 to dev (internal back-merge; no content changes) |

## Contributors

Thanks to @Yeachan-Heo for the native-hook logging fix and release back-merge.

**Full Changelog**: [`v0.21.35...v0.21.36`](https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-codex/compare/v0.21.35...v0.21.36)

body:
> _"What's your name?" — 《Your Name.》 (2016)_ ## ✨ What's New | Feature | Description | By | | --- | --- | --- | | **Kimi support** _(off by default)_ | Folders, Conversation export, Comfortable Reading Width, Reading Typography, Ctrl/⌘+Enter to send, Draft auto-save, Draft counter, Quote replies and Site check now run on Kimi; turn on the ones you want under Plugins. (closes #1038) | — | | **Folders stay with their own account** | With account isolation on, folders, Drive sync and Folder as Project's instructions follow the Google account you're on; an unreadable account is reported instead of loading forever. | — | | **Gemini: new chat in a folder without a reload** | With Folder as Project on, **New chat in this folder** opens a new chat right away with that folder picked. | — | | **Site check** _(off by default)_ | See how many of the page elements Voyager relies on were found, and pick the part that looks broken; the report has no chat content and is ready for an issue. | — | | **Claude and DeepSeek export** _(off by default)_ | Turn on **Conversation export** under Plugins to save a whole conversation to a file, read from start to finish. | — | | **Voyager on phones** | On Firefox for Android, the timelines, Gemini and ChatGPT export and the visual effects work; other plugins say they aren't available on phones yet. (closes #1066) | PR #1068 by @ccch1mneyyy | | **Parallel Local Bridge jobs** _(off by default)_ | Several [Voyager CLI](https://github.com/voyager-crew/voyager-cli) jobs run at once, each in its own ChatGPT tab (CLI 0.5.0 or later). | PR #1067 by @ccch1mneyyy | ## 🐛 Bug Fixes | Fix | Description | By | | --- | --- | --- | | **Gemini: Recent Gems** | Now that Gemini keeps Gems under **More**, Recent Gems appear in their own **Gems** section of the sidebar. | — | | **ChatGPT: export without signing in** | Conversations opened while signed out (`/uc/` links) show the Export button and export normally. | PR #1068 by @ccch1mneyyy | | **AI Studio folder layout** | The Folders heading lines up with the nav, and prompts are indented under their folder. | — | | **AI Studio settings apply at once** | **Hide archived conversations** controls AI Studio itself, and turning folders on or off needs no reload. | — | | **ChatGPT: dragging chats into folders** | Dragging a chat in the sidebar no longer drops halfway. | — | | **Hide archived conversations** | Takes effect as soon as it's turned on, and never hides chats that aren't in a folder. | — | | **Claude's redesigned sidebar** | Voyager finds Claude's sidebar again after its redesign. | — | | **Local Bridge model switching** | Voyager CLI reports a model switch only once the menu has closed and the model really changed. | — | | **Firefox sakura effect** | No longer shows a patch of background on dark pages. | — | --- ## 中文版 > _「你的名字是？」——《你的名字。》（2016）_ ## ✨ 新功能 | 功能 | 说明 | 提交者 | | --- | --- | --- | | **支持 Kimi** _（默认关闭）_ | 文件夹、会话导出、舒适阅读宽度、阅读排版、Ctrl/⌘+Enter 发送、草稿自动保存、输入框字数统计、引用回复和站点检查都能在 Kimi 上用，在插件里按需打开。（关联 #1038） | — | | **多账户下文件夹不再串号** | 开启账户隔离后，文件夹、Drive 同步和「文件夹作为项目」的指令只属于当前 Google 账户；认不出账户时直接说明，不再一直转圈。 | — | | **Gemini 在文件夹中新建对话不再刷新** | 开启「文件夹作为项目」后，点 **在此文件夹新建对话** 直接打开新对话，并选好这个文件夹。 | — | | **站点检查** _（默认关闭）_ | 看到 Voyager 依赖的每个页面元素找到了几个，还能点选出问题的区域；报告不含聊天内容，可直接用来提交 Issue。 | — | | **Claude 和 DeepSeek 导出** _（默认关闭）_ | 在插件里打开 **会话导出**，把整段对话从头到尾导出成文件。 | — | | **手机上的 Voyager** | 在 Firefox for Android 上，时间轴、Gemini 和 ChatGPT 导出、视觉特效照常可用；其他插件会标明手机上暂不支持。（关联 #1066） | PR #1068 by @ccch1mneyyy | | **本地桥并行运行任务** _（默认关闭）_ | 多个 [Voyager CLI](https://github.com/voyager-crew/voyager-cli) 任务同时进行，每个任务各用一个 ChatGPT 标签页（需要 CLI 0.5.0 及以上）。 | PR #1067 by @ccch1mneyyy | ## 🐛 修复 | 修复 | 说明 | 提交者 | | --- | --- | --- | | **Gemini 最近 Gems** | Gemini 把 Gems 收进「更多」后，最近 Gems 显示在侧栏里单独的「Gems」分组中。 | — | | **ChatGPT 未登录也能导出** | 没登录时打开的对话（`/uc/` 链接）也会显示导出按钮，可以正常导出。 | PR #1068 by @ccch1mneyyy | | **AI Studio 文件夹排版** | 「文件夹」标题和左栏对齐，文件夹里的提示词有了缩进。 | — | | **AI Studio 设置即时生效** | 「隐藏已归档对话」管的是 AI Studio 自己；开关文件夹不用再刷新页面。 | — | | **ChatGPT 拖对话进文件夹** | 在侧栏拖对话时不会再半路断掉。 | — | | **隐藏已归档对话** | 打开后立刻生效，也不会误藏还没放进文件夹的对话。 | — | | **Claude 侧栏改版** | Claude 改版后，Voyager 又能找到它的侧栏了。 | — | | **本地桥切换模型** | Voyager CLI 切换模型时，要等菜单关上、模型确实切换后才报告成功。 | — | | **Firefox 樱花特效** | 在深色页面上不再出现一块底色。 | — | --- **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/voyager-crew/voyager/compare/v2.2.0...v2.2.1 ## 📥 Installation
     

Edge users: Voyager is still maintained on Edge Add-ons for users who need Edge on mobile or tablet. If review is delayed, Chrome Web Store and GitHub manual packages remain available.

- **Chrome / Edge / Chromium browsers**: `voyager-chrome-v2.2.1.zip` - **Firefox**: `voyager-firefox-v2.2.1.xpi` - **Safari**: `voyager-v2.2.1.dmg` > Do not use GitHub's auto-generated **Source code (zip/tar.gz)** archives for manual extension installs. Those files are repository source snapshots, not browser-ready extension packages.
🍎 Safari 安装与升级说明 (Safari installation & upgrade) > 🎉 从 v1.6.0 起，Voyager 的核心功能已正式覆盖 Safari。 > Starting with v1.6.0, Voyager's core experience is officially supported on Safari. - 📦 **安装 (Installation)**: 下载并打开 `voyager-v2.2.1.dmg`，按提示安装应用。 Download and open `voyager-v2.2.1.dmg`, then follow the prompts to install the app. - ⚠️ **旧版升级 (Legacy upgrade)**: 如果仍安装着 `Gemini Voyager.app`，请先完成一次 [Safari 迁移步骤](https://voyager.nagi.fun/guide/safari-migration)，避免两个 App 并存。 If `Gemini Voyager.app` is still installed, follow the one-time [Safari migration guide](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/safari-migration) first so the two apps do not conflict. - 🖼️ **图片能力 (Images)**: Image Refinement 水印去除、全尺寸图片下载与聊天导出中的图片提取均已支持。 Image Refinement watermark removal, full-size image downloads, and image extraction in conversation exports are supported. - ☁️ **原生云同步 (Native cloud sync)**: Google Drive 与 iCloud 同步均已接入 Safari 原生层。 Google Drive and iCloud sync are integrated through Safari's native layer. - 🔔 **系统通知 (Notifications)**: Gemini 回复完成后可发送 macOS 通知，并直达对应对话。 macOS can notify you when a Gemini response finishes and open the matching conversation. - 🔄 **自动更新 (Automatic updates)**: 完成这次迁移后，后续版本可通过 Sparkle 自动更新。 After this one-time migration, future versions can update automatically through Sparkle.

name: v5.1.47
body:
- Memory path-state recovery and commit hooks now keep literal Git lookups working when global glob or case-insensitive pathspec modes are enabled ([#11130](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11130), [#11167](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11167)). (batch [#11187](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11187))

**A user Stop pauses the workflow run it started instead of cancelling it.** DAG nodes, workpool workers and task children hold where they are; a message to the paused run or Resume continues it from where it stopped. ([#10808](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10808), fixes [#6752](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/6752)) (batch [#11187](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11187))

**Concurrent file touches show each project memory nudge once.** Project memory reads reserve the nudge before asynchronous loading, retry failed reads, and discard stale results after compaction or session changes. ([#11165](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11165), addresses item 1 of [#10927](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10927)) (batch [#11187](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11187))

**A finished workflow run now shows as a finished run.** When a workflow (DAG) run started from a session completes, including one that completes after recovery, the engine records the session's completion as a finished run instead of a plain reply ([#11155](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11155)). (batch [#11187](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11187))

**A finished ulw-execute plan now shows as a finished run.** When this session's own ulw-execute work is marked completed, the engine records the session's completion as a finished run instead of a plain reply. Work finished by an earlier run, abandoned work, and another session's work are not counted ([#11174](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11174)). (batch [#11187](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11187))

**A completed ulw-loop plan now shows as a finished run.** When this session's ulw-loop plan reaches its aggregate completion, the engine records the session's completion as a finished run instead of a plain reply. A plan that was already complete when the session started is not counted ([#11175](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11175)). (batch [#11187](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11187))

**CI exposes the lint ratchet as its own required-free status check.** Pull requests, pushes and merge groups run `Lint ratchet` independently of the heavy-validation typecheck path. ([#11128](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11128), thanks @Dante-dan) (batch [#11187](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11187))

**The 10k parked-backlog memory test now fails if it observed no entry reads.** ([#11164](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11164), part of [#11091](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11091), thanks @Dante-dan) (batch [#11187](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11187))

**omo.dev/download no longer answers 404.** Desktop builds link it from the reinstall screen and the .deb update pill; while the site's own download page is off, `/download` and `/<locale>/download` now redirect to the public beta download page at https://get.omo.dev/desktop/beta/. ([#11270](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11270))

**Gateway wakes, UI answers and releases reach a host session known only by its durable id.** A multi-session host refuses any command that names no session, so a wake for a session read from disk or found by `thread locate` was lost with `missing_session_id`. The client now looks the session up on its host by durable id and routes the command; when no live session holds it, the delivery stays queued for the session's next start and `omo thread report` says the completion's wake did not reach it. ([#11188](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11188), fixes [#11185](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11185), part of [#10995](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10995)) ([#11252](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11252))

**Turning telemetry off through an environment variable no longer deletes summaries another session queued under a profile.** A session whose `OMO_PROFILE` turns telemetry on could lose its queued usage summary when another session started with `DO_NOT_TRACK` and the base `omo.json` setting was off. Each summary queued from now on remembers the config it was recorded under and is judged by it when it is sent, resumed or cleaned up; summaries queued before the upgrade keep the old reading until they expire. ([#11198](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11198)) ([#11202](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11202)) ([#11252](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11252))

**The telemetry reference now states exactly which queued summaries an opt-out deletes and what the legacy `rollups` cleanup can and cannot remove.** ([#11181](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11181)) ([#11252](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11252))

**senpi's on-demand memory report now shows OmO's task children and memory recall.** With `SENPI_MEMORY_REPORT=1`, a report gains an `omoTask` section (resident task children, cached task records and their bytes, open event logs) and an `omoRecall` section (loaded memory corpora, their text bytes, the recall index's term arrays and dictionary size), so a large session's memory can be traced to these layers. Nothing is measured unless a report is taken. ([#11178](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11178), part of [#9442](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9442)) ([#11252](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11252))

**Kimi K3.1 gets its own Sisyphus, Sisyphus-Junior and Atlas prompts.** Kimi K3.1 Pro ids (`k3.1-pro`, `kimi-k3.1-pro` and their Highspeed versions) now route to separate copies of the K3 prompts instead of sharing K3's, and the Kimi Code id `k3.1-pro` gets a Kimi prompt at all. `kimi-k3.1-pro` maps to Kimi Code's `k3.1-pro` id. ([#11197](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11197)) ([#11252](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11252))

**Protocol-2 account storage has separate credential and pending-revocation namespaces.** Legacy credential writes and deletes cannot overwrite either namespace; the origin key and native storage-error mappings stay shared. This is storage support for the protocol-2 rollout, not enrollment activation. ([#11177](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11177), refs [omo-service#628](https://github.com/sisyphuslabs/omo-service/issues/628)) ([#11252](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11252))

**A background task whose task host stays unreachable no longer comes back as a leftover session after recovery gives up.** When a task child's reconnect timed out and its host answered only later, the stalled reconnect could retry after the session had already been closed and reopen it on the host, leaving a live session and its processes behind. The abandoned reconnect now stops retrying, while the parked child keeps its respawn and its single notice. ([#11246](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11246), fixes [#10925](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10925)) ([#11252](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11252))

**Windows Codex commands no longer stop at a command syntax error.** Generated command shims accept a quoted `NODE_REPL_NODE_PATH` in `config.toml` and also run when that setting or the config file is absent. Thanks to @fvegiard for the report and @LilMGenius for the fix. ([#11222](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11222), fixes [#7473](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/7473)) ([#11252](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11252))

**The ulw-research proofread lane returns edits that are checked before they land.** The writing lane hands back `polish-edits.json`; `fact polish-apply` applies each edit only when it changes text nodes alone and keeps every number, hedge, qualifier, link, and claim id, `fact polish-diff` backstops hand edits, and `fact pairs --changed-since` sends every sentence polish rewrote back to the meaning readers. ([#11160](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11160), part of [#11009](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11009))

**Changelog entries live in per-PR fragments, so pull requests stop conflicting on the changelogs.** A pull request that changes what ships adds exactly one file, `changes/unreleased/<pr-number>.md`: the paragraph that used to go under `## [Unreleased]` (or `### Fixed`-style bullets), plus a `<!-- changes-log: <path> -->` block for each entry it used to prepend to `changes.md` or `packages/<name>/changes.md`. Only the release pull request edits those files: the release workflow writes every fragment into the release section and the logs, and deletes the fragments. What counts as shipped is unchanged, and `bun script/changelog-fragments-cli.ts from-diff --base origin/dev --pr <n>` converts a branch that still edits the changelogs. ([#10477](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10477))

### Fixed

- Commands OmO starts under Bun now see environment changes made while it runs, as they already did under Node. Before, a child started without an explicit environment got the values the process started with, so it could run with an out-of-date temp or home directory. ([#11260](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11260)) ([#11252](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11252))

name: v5.1.46
body:
**OmO Native init-deep committed mode no longer dead-ends.** Committed mode now finishes through its own pull-request handoff instead of pointing at a skill that does not ship with OmO Native, and it reports how to finish by hand when no PR can be opened. Thanks to @HolisticDeveloper for the report and @surlymochan for the fix. ([#11228](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11228), fixes [#9686](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9686))

**The stale-reflection-lock test leaves no background writer behind when removing its temporary root.** Its teardown closes the memory wiring and awaits facts reconciliation and maintenance before removal, so a late lock publication cannot recreate the directory and make the temp-leak guard blame another test. ([#11225](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11225))

**ulw-research ships a Markdown block model for checking Markdown and post deliverables.** It splits a Markdown report into headings, paragraphs, list items, table rows, code blocks and quotes with exact text offsets, and sorts sections with the same classifier as the HTML checks; an unclosed code fence is reported instead of passing silently, and no check uses it yet. The HTML checks now also treat a section headed exactly "Closing" as the closing section. ([#11153](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11153), part of [#11009](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11009))

**ulw-research ships checked polish edits and a polish diff for research reports.** Polish changes text nodes only: tags, every attribute, comments, and script/style/template content stay byte-identical, including attribute order and quoting. `polish-apply` rejects markup changes and edits that change a fact, number, unit, ticker, or required hedge, and checks cumulative edits against the original report; `polish-diff` applies the same rules to the whole report. An edit may not contain `<`, `>` or `&`, and may not touch a character reference even without them; both gates also compare the whole-document skeleton (every markup token and every character reference, byte for byte), so entities and markup are left untouched. Both gates refuse documents with markup the checker cannot model exactly. Markup changes require the full fidelity gates. Severities come from the defect registry. Nothing in the CLI calls them yet. ([#11152](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11152), part of [#11009](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11009))

**Re-extracting a conversation no longer counts the same agreement correction again.** Corrections are bound to validated user turns and recorded atomically with their replay receipts. Distinct turns on the same date still count separately; acknowledgement, drop and eviction retain replay history. Pending records from older versions use a documented agreement/date migration. ([#11214](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11214), fixes [#11191](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11191))

**The LSP MCP server negotiates supported protocol versions.** It preserves supported client versions and answers unsupported or missing versions with `2025-06-18`, rather than claiming an arbitrary protocol revision. ([#11208](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11208))

**Skill MCP tool errors are reported as errors.** Structured output and result metadata reach the caller, tool failures are not retried as connection failures, and plain content keeps its existing output format. ([#11207](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11207))

**The repository now has a security policy.** `SECURITY.md` explains how to report a vulnerability privately through GitHub's Security tab, what to include, and when to expect triage and an acknowledgement; `CONTRIBUTING.md` links to it. Adapted from the policy proposed by @marklapointe in [#10752](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10752). ([#11221](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11221))

**ulw-research can check that a report's sentences keep the meaning of their sources.** It pairs each report sentence with the quote, claim or original text it rests on, and records drift only when two independent readers name the same kind of change; a single reader's flag is kept as a minor warning. A pair no reader judged, or a pair that needs the strong reader and only got the cheap one, is reported as unverified instead of passing as clean. Nothing in the CLI runs it yet. ([#11151](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11151), part of [#11009](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11009))

**Skill MCP catalogs include every page.** Tools, resources, and prompts follow opaque pagination cursors in order, with a clear error if a server exceeds 100 pages. ([#11204](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11204))

**`omo update` on Windows survives a package file that another process holds.** When `bun add -g` fails with `EPERM` (`NtSetInformationFile`) because a file of the install is in use, `omo update` retries twice with a short backoff. If the file stays held, it names the file and the omo processes holding it, tells you to quit them and run `omo update` again, and keeps whatever version is installed, reinstalling the previous one only if the failed run left an unreadable install. ([#10090](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10090), [#11125](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11125))

**A held abandoned test directory no longer fails a new run during preload.** Cleanup retries through the shared tree remover, skips roots still held with EBUSY, EPERM, ENOTEMPTY or EACCES, and continues with the other abandoned roots. Unrelated filesystem errors still fail the run, and Bun's panic-only retry keeps its existing test-failure checks. ([#11190](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11190), refs [#11135](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11135) and [#8990](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/8990))

**Usage summaries from older versions no longer stay on disk after an upgrade.** Versions 5.1.34 to 5.1.44 kept session summaries in a `rollups` folder that nothing reads or sends any more. The first start after upgrading now deletes it, whether telemetry is on or off, and never follows a link out of that folder. With telemetry turned off in `omo.json`, a summary file that was cut short by a crash is deleted too. ([#10234](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10234)) ([#11147](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11147)) (batch [#11168](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11168))

**Computer-use cancellation retains engine crash diagnostics.** Cancelled and timed-out calls keep their error code and carry the engine exit diagnostic as their cause. Capability-query permission failures remain structured tool results, hard engine diagnostics survive unrelated successful replies, and legacy launch refusals now share the structured record's exit-code and UTF-8 size rules. ([#11150](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11150)) Follow-up to [#11086](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11086), part of [#11073](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11073). (batch [#11168](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11168))

**Reflection and dream children share a machine-wide FIFO concurrency cap.** The default is one running child across memory identities, configurable with `memory.reflection.max_concurrent_runs`. Queued runs retain their execution budget and remain protected from crash reconciliation until admitted. ([#11161](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11161), fixes [#11154](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11154)) (batch [#11168](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11168))

**Memory reflection no longer stops for good when its host dies during a run.** If the host died after a run had finished but before it was published, `runtime/reflection/active.lock` stayed held and every later reflection request only queued behind it until someone removed the file by hand. Now `/reflect` and every later turn settle a run whose launcher and publish claimant are both gone and whose outcome was recorded, so the queued request runs. A lock whose owner can't be checked is never reclaimed; it is reported with the next step, in the session and in `omo doctor`. Thanks to @Bearmancer for the report. ([#10377](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10377), [#10388](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10388), [#10528](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10528)) (batch [#11168](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11168))

**One bad memory entry no longer discards a whole reflection run, and credential-shaped prose is not a secret.** Completion validation used to fail the entire run when any entry was refused (secret-like content, invalid frontmatter, a `description` over 1024 characters), so automatic reflection parked after a few runs. It now rewrites the run's branch as one commit without the refused entries, keeps the valid ones, and reports each dropped path with its reason (never the matched value); a run whose entries are all refused lands as no changes. The secret scanner and the pre-commit hook no longer flag assignments whose value only refers to a secret (`process.env.X`, `$VAR`, `{{ slot }}`, `[FILTERED]`, the `Bearer` word, null/example literals), while a real value still matches. The dream's `path_orphan` finding now says when a file has no frontmatter, and its persona tells it to add a `description` in the same commit as the move instead of a bare `git mv`, which validation refused on every run. Thanks to @PGY0403 (#10385) and @floweredao (#10511) for the reports. ([#10385](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10385), [#10511](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10511), [#10528](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10528)) (batch [#11168](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11168))

**Held packaging-test directories are recorded without failing cleanup.** The packed memory-sync probe and abandoned-root sweep share one best-effort removal guard, with no retries. Every held root is printed in the test log; Windows diagnostics are bounded to 30 seconds and include the holder's pid, image and parent pid when identified, or the diagnostic failure. Unrelated filesystem errors and unrecorded leaks still fail. ([#11218](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11218), part of [#11135](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11135))

name: CC Switch v4.0.20
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.20

本版本新增对 Oh My Pi 的支持，它是 CC Switch 管理的第 13 个应用：多个供应商可以同时写进它的 `models.yml`，MCP、Skills、提示词同步给 Oh My Pi，会话可以浏览和恢复，「应用」页可以安装、升级、卸载 Oh My Pi。「应用」页分成「已安装」「未安装」两组，已安装的应用可以拖动排序，侧栏跟着这个顺序。Kimi 官方账号的卡片现在可以编辑模型、从 Kimi Code 里移除；托管的 ChatGPT 账号可以用浏览器登录。另外修复了 DeepSeek 余额用完后显示成「套餐已过期」、Kimi Code 子代理的用量没有统计、Skills 更新一直报 HTTP 429、Pi 的 API Key 写成环境变量引用时额度查询 401、Claude Code 会话标题显示成 `<local-command-stdout>`、Linux 上开启应用级窗口按钮后页头拖不动等问题。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.20-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.20-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### Oh My Pi

Oh My Pi（命令是 `omp`）现在是一个独立的应用，有自己的供应商、MCP、Skills、提示词和会话（[#6747](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/6747)、[#8308](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8308)）。配置在 `~/.omp/agent`，用了命名 profile 时在 `~/.omp/profiles/<名称>/agent`；也可以在设置里改成别的目录。

- **供应商可以同时启用。** 和 Pi 一样，卡片上是「启用」「移除」，多个供应商同时写进 `models.yml`，在 Oh My Pi 里选用。只改 CC Switch 写的那一条，文件里其他内容原样保留；用了 YAML 锚点、标签这类写法的条目不会被重写，会提示你手动修改。
- **写入前按 Oh My Pi 的规则检查。** Oh My Pi 只要有一条供应商不合规，就会停用所有自定义供应商，所以填了它不接受的值，保存时会直接提示，不会写进去。只有旧版的 `models.json`、还没有 `models.yml` 时，会提示你先运行一次 `omp`，让它自己迁移，不会新建文件挤掉你原来的供应商。
- **添加供应商。** 表单和 Pi 共用，预设也来自 Pi 的目录；「获取模型列表」后在弹窗里勾选模型。「模型自动发现」（让 Oh My Pi 自己去接口查有哪些模型）和请求头、兼容选项一起放在「高级选项」里。API Key 可以写环境变量名，查询额度时 CC Switch 会按 Oh My Pi 的规则取出实际的值。
- **MCP、Skills、提示词。** MCP 写进 `mcp.json`，Skills 装进 Oh My Pi 自己的技能目录，提示词写进 `AGENTS.md`。Oh My Pi 还会从其他工具的目录里找 MCP 和技能，实际加载的可能比 CC Switch 里列出的多，MCP 和 Skills 页 Oh My Pi 一列的说明里有解释。
- **会话。** 可以浏览和恢复 Oh My Pi 的会话，预览里能显示项目里的图片。
- **「应用」页管理 Oh My Pi。** 用官方安装脚本安装（装了 Bun 就用 Bun，没装就下载官方的二进制），升级运行 `omp update`（用 Homebrew 装的仍然走 Homebrew），可以卸载。
- Oh My Pi 不经过本地路由，也暂不统计用量。

### 托管 ChatGPT 账号可以用浏览器登录

在授权中心或 Codex 的供应商表单里添加托管 ChatGPT 账号时，可以在「登录方式」里选「浏览器登录」（[#8288](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8288)、[#8284](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8284)）。有些企业工作区关掉了设备代码登录，这些账号以前加不进来；重新登录也可以用浏览器。「设备代码登录」仍然可选。

## 改进

**「应用」页分成「已安装」「未安装」两组。** 每组标题带数量，没有应用的组不显示；刚打开、还在检测时先显示一整张表，检测完再分组，行不会一个个跳。Claude Desktop 没有命令可查，按是否装了 Desktop 来分组，行里照旧写是否已接入 CC Switch。

**已安装的应用可以拖动排序。** 鼠标移到某一行上，行首会出现拖动手柄，和供应商卡片排序一样。侧栏和默认打开的应用都跟着这个顺序；顺序只存在本机，不随云同步。

**Kimi 官方账号的卡片可以编辑和移除。** 以前官方卡片只能在授权中心管理，模型停在登录时的那一份。现在可以编辑卡片：连接和登录仍由授权中心管，这里只改模型，「获取模型列表」读取这个账号当前可用的官方模型，带上官方的上下文窗口、能力和思考档位。官方卡片也可以像其他 Kimi 供应商一样从 Kimi Code 里「移除」，卡片和登录都保留，再点「添加」就恢复；要删除，先移除，或者到授权中心删。

**没有 Kimi Code 套餐的 Kimi 账号显示「未订阅」。** 以前授权中心和官方卡片的额度一栏是空的，看起来像查询失败。

**余额用完也显示金额。** 余额为零或欠费时，供应商卡片和托盘以前只写「余额已用完」，看不出欠了多少，红字也和「额度查询失败」分不清。现在一律显示「余额 <金额>」，为零或负数时卡片上整行变红、托盘里变成橙色，和以前一样。

**额度查询失败的中文提示改成「额度查询失败」**（以前是「额度没查到」），供应商卡片、授权中心和托盘一起改。

**Pi 获取模型列表后在弹窗里勾选。** 以前只能逐行从下拉框里选，现在和 OpenCode、Codex、Kimi Code 一样弹出列表，勾选的模型自动加成一行，从预设或 models.dev 补上参数；取消勾选会删掉对应的行。逐行的下拉框还在。

**Pi 的请求头和兼容选项收进「高级选项」。** 默认收起，和 Claude Code、Codex 的表单一致；兼容选项的说明改成了白话。

**Claude Code、Claude Desktop 选 GitHub Copilot 供应商时，上游格式显示为「由路由按模型自动选择」**（[#8196](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8196)、[#8195](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8195)）。Copilot 的上游格式本来就按模型自动选，以前表单里还能手选，选了也不生效。

**用量页明细页签的数量一次全显示。** 以前「模型」页签要点开才有数量，切换应用时三个数量会消失再出现，页签栏跟着跳。

**价格表新增 Kimi K3.1 Pro 和 K3.1 Pro HighSpeed。**

**土耳其语翻译补全**（[#8616](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8616)）。

**预设：** 各家预设的模型更新到当前的最新型号，填上 Key 就能用。

## 修复

- **DeepSeek 余额为零或欠费时，卡片和托盘显示「套餐已过期」，余额数字不见了**（[#8812](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8812)）。DeepSeek 返回的「是否可用」只表示余额够不够调用，余额一到零就变成否，Key 本身仍然有效。现在照常显示余额；Key 真的失效时，仍按认证失败提示。
- **Kimi Code 子代理的用量没有统计进来**（[#8792](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8792)）。Kimi Code 把每个子代理的记录写在单独的文件里，以前只读了主代理的那份。现在每个子代理都会导入，按每次调用记账，不会和主代理的汇总重复计算。
- **Antigravity 子代理和 ACP 会话的用量记成未知模型**（[#8693](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8693)）。现在从 agy 本地的对话数据库里找回模型（只读，不会等 agy 写完）。
- **Skills 安装或更新一直报 HTTP 429**（[#8813](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8813)）。下载 GitHub 仓库压缩包时没带 User-Agent，GitHub 对这类请求限流更严，多人共用一个出口 IP 时更容易碰到。现在会带上 `CC-Switch/<version>`。
- **Pi 的 API Key 写成 `$NAME`、`${NAME}` 这类环境变量引用时，额度和余额查询报 401**（[#8822](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8822)）。以前把引用原样当成 Key 发出去，现在按 Pi 的规则取出变量的值；变量没设置时，也不会再把引用当成 Key 发出去。`!command` 形式的 Key，CC Switch 仍然不会执行。取出的值只用于这次查询，不写回配置。
- **Claude Code 会话在会话管理里的标题显示成 `<local-command-stdout>Set model to opus</local-command-stdout>`**（[#8799](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8799)、[#8798](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8798)）。会话一开头运行了 `/model`、`/effort` 这类本地命令时，标题会这样；最后运行了本地命令时，列表里显示的最后一条消息也是命令输出。现在会跳过这些记录。
- **Linux 上开启「启用应用级窗口按钮」后，页头拖不动窗口，窗口边缘也没有缩放光标**（[#8092](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8092)、[#8091](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8091)）。
- **Codex 经 Chat 上游时，带图片的孤立工具结果里，占位文字说图片在「下一条消息」里，实际并没有这条消息**（[#8157](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8157)）。现在改成说图片已经作为图片附上。

## 升级说明

**数据库版本从 22 升到 23**，为 MCP 增加 Oh My Pi 的开关。升级前会自动备份数据库；升级后再退回旧版本，旧版本会提示数据库版本过新，打不开。

- Oh My Pi 默认显示在侧栏，不用的话可以在「应用」页关掉「在侧栏显示 Oh My Pi」。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @JackieJK、@allenxu09（Oh My Pi 支持）、@Llugaes（ChatGPT 账号浏览器登录）、@dsdbb520（Antigravity 子代理用量）、@L4XB（Claude Code 会话标题）、@vianrina（Linux 窗口拖动）、@Railgun-wiki（Copilot 上游格式）、@NeeYoonc（孤立工具结果的图片占位）、@alkank（土耳其语翻译）的贡献。

感谢 @CypressStar、@taylortaurus、@SoraStr、@Lain-in-coding、@TomMao23、@L-Molish、@taki-ohh 报告问题、提供复现信息和修复思路。

特别感谢以下贡献者：你们的 PR 发现并修复了真实的问题，只是同样的问题后来在主线上另行修好，PR 因此关闭。@yvzhou1111、@AkimioJR、@KirisameLonnet。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。
